completed: Normal action updates require loaded student/revision intent and use one authenticated-only database RPC; no raw or legacy fallback. Exact actor/student/row/microsecond/effect receipts are validated.
Current student reading proof and role locks remain held through commit/rollback; editors also hold editing proof. An assignee without current student reading proof is refused.
Action row, completion activity and linked report stale marker commit together or all roll back. Suppressed/mismatched effect receipts cannot leave a successful action behind.
No-op, completion-label aliases and stale retries cannot duplicate activity. Competing old versions cannot overwrite a committed newer update.
Current read-only assignees preserve their existing action-edit capability. The RPC can mark only the linked report-derived stale metadata; it does not alter content or grant report access.
All old records, routine bodies, policies and table grants remain unchanged; one private revision trigger adds increasing microsecond versions for subsequent updates.
remaining: Raw/cached/trusted writers outside the new RPC remain available under existing rules and do not gain RPC atomicity or loaded-version enforcement. Their authority/identity/completion paths remain open.
Other action CRUD and goals/student/profile/BridgeForward/privacy/caseload work remains in P1; the eight endpoint inventory entries remain review-required.
Final routine catalogue/canonical/ledger packaging, target impact review, combined release regression and separately authorized hosted rollout/role/mobile/demo/provider acceptance remain open.
